answer: Proof of stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where each vertex in the network requires locked collateral to participate in consensus. An attacker attempting to flood the nebula of nodes with fake identities incurs a prohibitive cost, as they must acquire vast capital which is then subject to slashing. Like a unique pigment marking verified assets, stake differentiates honest actors from sybils, forcing attackers to burn value rather than simply generating new digital identifiers.
